confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregated UK-wide and Belfast estimates (Citycost, Expatistan, Pint Tracker, Finder), mostly dated 2025 to early 2026, so they are ballpark. Beer is the best-supported anchor. Cocktail and wine_glass are weaker: no current 2026 Belfast cocktail survey was found, and no per-glass wine data was found, so wine_glass is inferred from restaurant wine markups and typical UK glass prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings. GBP-to-USD conversion uses an assumed rate of about 1.34 from general knowledge, not a sourced observation. The FX observation is the 15 Oct 2026 RBA figure, which appeared on two rba.gov.au pages in search results. The 16 Oct figure was not verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Belfast-specific aggregated estimates, cross-checked against UK regional city levels. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized UK regional city in July, based on general knowledge of Belfast demand.
